violations.why: After enable_isr(1), quiver can run between the check and the reset and modify v_umber, so the reset acts on a stale check.
Quiver enables raptor, which can then increment v_umber between the task's check and its reset.
Before the interrupts are disabled, pylon can overwrite v_umber, so the task reads a value it did not write.
Quiver can modify v_umber between the task's write and its later read.
The increment in quiver is not atomic. Higher-priority pylon can preempt it, and its update is lost.
The increment in raptor can be preempted by higher-priority pylon, and its update is lost.
